saves.dcUnknown: The challenge DC is unknown: enter it in the message block.
saves.changedAfterApply: The "{item}" challenge result for "{name}" changed after it was applied (reroll). Press "Undo" or "Apply" in the block.
saves.macroNoPerm: the GM lacks the MACRO_SCRIPT permission

opt.agitate-moved: Strode, flew or swam this turn (no damage)

apply.immune: "{name}" is immune to this effect — not applied.
apply.alreadyImmune: "{name}" is temporarily immune to this effect — not applied.
apply.repeatTaken: "{name}" already has this condition or effect — repeat save not attached, the existing one is left alone.
apply.repeatNoDC: "{name}": the repeat-save DC is unknown — not applied.
apply.needEnemy: "{name}": target exactly one enemy (for the mark) — effect not applied.
apply.noChoice: "{name}": no option chosen — effect not applied.
apply.noCandidates: "{name}": nobody to choose on the scene — steps for the chosen creature skipped.
apply.zeroPersistent: "{name}": persistent damage is 0 at this level — not applied.
apply.noOption: "{name}": no toggleable option {option} — not turned on.
apply.noCastEffect: "{name}": no effect of this casting to extend — extend it by hand or press Apply again once the effect appears.
apply.noWalls: "{name}": the scene is not open — allies in range are counted without walls.
